cleanup_hook_design_implications: SALVAGE-FIRST is non-negotiable: 31/32 momentstudio worktrees are DIRTY and ALL 32 branches are UNMERGED — a naive `git worktree prune`/blind-remove hook would destroy uncommitted + unmerged work. The hook MUST diff-and-report (uncommitted delta + `main..worktree` commits + associated stashes) and require salvage-ack before removal.

`git worktree prune` is INSUFFICIENT/UNSAFE here — none of the 32 are prunable (dirs exist, no locked/prunable flag); they need explicit `git worktree remove` which refuses on dirty trees (good default). Hook should surface, not force.

OWNERSHIP GATE: key removal on live-session ownership. Signals proven useful: (a) dir mtime today, (b) a running claude/codex whose domain matches (BC_ULTRA_SESSION ⇒ quarantine bc-toolkit-*-wt though weeks-dormant), (c) the active worktree branch of any live workflow. mtime-today=0 across momentstudio confirms safe.

STASH-AWARENESS: 5 of 7 momentstudio stashes are keyed to worktree-<id> branches — removing a worktree orphans its stash. Hook must enumerate `git stash list` and map stashes to worktrees before remove.

ORPHAN-BRANCH sweep: worktree-agent-a4a31c75 has a branch but no dir; and `agent-skills-toolchain-ralph` has a dir but no .git. The hook needs to reconcile BOTH directions (branch-without-dir and dir-without-git).

MERGED-LEAF pruning is the safe win: 24 toolchain local branches map to merged PRs — a `gh`-backed 'branch is merged on remote' check (NOT stale local origin/main) is the reliable signal to offer branch deletion.
DON'T re-budget stale numbers: the 46.5GB is gone; the live reclaimable is ~13.96 GB (13.2 momentstudio + 0.76 ~/worktrees) + the ds-tmp/Downloads long tail.
